name: Domain Bound Scaling
description: The universe of available elements is changed from {1, 2, ..., T} to the first T positive even integers {2, 4, ..., 2T}, introducing W = 2T as the maximum value in the text. The total capacity remains exactly T, perfectly preserving the mathematical conditions for both certificates (p1+p2 > T and sum > T). However, models relying on surface-level pattern matching will extract the explicitly defined maximum value W from the text and erroneously use it as the capacity limit, thus failing the checks.
